system.description: A bolt of lightning leaps between the hearts of the wicked, striking d6 creatures, each within 30' of the last. If no foe is in reach, it leaps to an ally.

outcomes.success: Each creature struck takes 3d6 damage. A creature already damaged by another source this round takes an additional d6.
outcomes.failure: The bolt strikes only the first creature, for half damage.
outcomes.ruin: The last leap comes home: you take d6 damage. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
